name: Hand Winch for Kitchen Maid® Clothes Airer
notes: Solid cast iron, based on a Lawson design of about 1880. Weight 5.5 kg, lifting capacity 15 kg, 11.5 turns per drum revolution, drum takes 10 m of rope. Retailer recommends pairing it with their Standard Double Pulley (I43). A seconds version (A2366S, grinds slightly) was listed at £135.00.
